title: Aim and Cost: en aras de, a costa de
goal: Use en aras de for the value someone serves and a costa de for the price paid.
grammar: en aras de, a costa de

items: I can use *en aras de* for the aim someone gives something up for.
I can use *a costa de* for what is lost along the way.
I can tell *en aras de* and *a costa de* from *con miras a*.
